jobs.title: Product Marketing, Growth
jobs.description:
ONWARDS TOGETHER!

Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.

Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave™ for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running.


LOCATION: 4 ON-SITE DAYS A WEEK IN SUNNYVALE, CA HEADQUARTERS.




OUR TEAM'S VISION:

Our Marketing team illuminates and evolves the global brand, driving revenue and empowering future success for our Sales team. As a leader in Zero Trust Segmentation, we are dedicated to helping organizations prevent cyberattacks and mitigate the impact of ransomware.

Renowned for our innovative solutions and collaborative spirit, we foster an inclusive environment within Marketing and across the company. Join one of the industry's most creative and dynamic teams, where you'll discover opportunities to excel, be empowered to set ambitious goals and define your path to success!

Product Marketing at Illumio:

The Product Marketing team at Illumio focuses on understanding the customer, technology, the ecosystem, market drivers, competition and customer needs with the responsibility of communicating product messaging and value to internal and external audiences. You will be part of a team responsible for developing positioning and differentiated messaging, defining go-to-market strategy, launching new solutions and driving thought leadership for the Illumio solutions. You will ‘roll up your sleeves’, ‘dig in’, learn, problem solve, be creative and do what it takes to win the market.

The role:

Product Marketing, Growth is a strategic initiative at Illumio to accelerate time-to-value for Customers. In this role, you will team with the head of PLG product marketing to define the overall Web Trial and Marketplaces experience to be delightful and useful for new prospects and existing customers. That includes managing the journeys including landing pages, email nurtures, and Trial asset such as blogs and videos. You will work closely with your product marketing peers, demand generation team, product management, within the Illumio Illumiverse community, directly with prospects, and the field.



YOUR IMPACT:

 - Journey definition and creation – Map the total prospect experience from researching about solving a problem, to learning about Illumio, to the different phases of a demo and Trial experience.

 - Sales enablement – Communicate value propositions to sales teams and develop sales materials and tools that support the selling process.

 - Trial aspects of product launches – plan the Trial updates for the go-to-market launch strategy for new releases, and manage the cross-functional implementation of the plan.

 - Market intelligence – learn about other Trial experience best practices from other vendors. Know the needs of our customers and prospects and be a knowledgeable authority on our competition with the ability to articulate value and differentiate our solutions.

 - Demand generation activities - Partner in demand generation activities with Marketing teams.

 - Cross-Departmental collaboration – Accomplish the above by having a constant communication flow with internal groups, including Marketing, Product Management, Sales and the office of the CTO.

 - Key product assets: written collateral, presentations, solution/demo videos, social media activities.


YOUR TOOLKIT:

 - Strong organizational, prioritization, project management and time management ability with a deadline focus

 - "You demonstrate “AI-first” mindset and expertise in researching and improving the quality, speed, and impact of your work."

 - 2+ years of product marketing experience in companies focused on enterprise security, data center or cloud infrastructure.

 - Strong right brain, left brain balance — analytical + creative

 - Demonstrated success of leading projects, launching products and driving product marketing activities

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills

 - Proactive and driven to solve problems and find innovative solutions

 - Strong acumen about new technologies and commercial acumen in the software industry

 - Strong business acumen and the ability to forge and maintain relationships.

 - Exceptional communication skills including the ability to influence, guide, and work with senior executives to achieve joint objectives

 - Experience of working in collaboration with a diverse range of business functions and customers to drive change and achieve delivery

 - Strong technical skills and experience

 - Demonstrated problem solving ability and attention to detail to deliver high-quality output

 - Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively across multiple time-zones

Our Commitment



Illumio believes that an environment of unique backgrounds, experiences, viewpoints, and individual contributions creates a culture of belonging, drives our future, and makes us stronger together in support of our customers and their success.



All official job offers from our company are extended directly by our recruitment team and will be sent through an official E-Signature document for your review and signature. jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
ONWARDS TOGETHER!

Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.

Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave™ for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running.


LOCATION: 5 ON-SITE DAYS A WEEK IN SUNNYVALE, CA HEADQUARTERS.




OUR TEAM'S VISION:

Our Product Management team is driven by a culture that thrives on visionary leadership, autonomy, and ownership, creating a dynamic synergy that drives us forward in the ever-evolving landscape of cybersecurity. We collaborate closely with our Engineering team to tackle real-world challenges our customers face.

Bring your visionary instincts to every stage of the product lifecycle—from conception and definition to development, release, and post-release activities. You'll play a pivotal role in strategic planning, feature selection, and day-to-day tactical operations. Together, our dynamic team propels the roadmap forward as we strive to make the digital world a safer place.




YOUR IMPACT:

We are seeking an experienced and highly technical Staff Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives across our cybersecurity platform. In this role, you will partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Security, Cloud Operations, Customer Success, and Support to deliver strategic programs that improve product quality, accelerate releases, and enable customers to adopt our platform with confidence.

You thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy solving ambiguous problems, and have a proven track record of leading large-scale technical programs from concept through delivery.

Technical Program Leadership

 - Lead complex, cross-functional programs spanning multiple engineering organizations from planning through successful delivery.

 - Drive execution of strategic initiatives across cloud, platform, security, infrastructure, and customer-facing product teams.

 - Establish program plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, and success metrics.

 - Develop and maintain reporting to provide regular program status updates.

Product Release Management

 - Own end-to-end release management for multiple product lines.

 - Coordinate release readiness activities across Engineering, Product Management, QA, Cloud Operations, Documentation and Customer Support

 - Drive release planning, Go/No-Go decisions, deployment readiness, and post-release reviews.

 - Improve release predictability through automation, metrics, and standardized processes.

Cross-functional Execution

 - Partner with product, engineering and cross functional leaders to identify risks, remove blockers, and drive timely execution.

 - Coordinate cross-team dependencies across distributed engineering organizations.

 - Lead technical discussions and facilitate alignment among stakeholders with competing priorities.

Operational Excellence

 - Define and improve program management best practices across the organization.

 - Build dashboards, KPIs, executive reporting, and portfolio health metrics.

 - Develop process improvements, automate workflows and develop tools for PMO efficiencies

 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on engineering efficiency, release quality, and operational scalability.

Customer & Strategic Initiatives

 - Lead strategic customer commitments and Voice of Customer (VoC) initiatives.

 - Partner with Product and Customer Success to prioritize customer-driven programs.

 - Coordinate large-scale initiatives involving SaaS migrations, platform modernization, and customer enablement.

Success in This Role

Successful candidates will:

 - Deliver complex technical programs on schedule with high quality.

 - Improve release predictability and execution excellence.

 - Build trusted partnerships across Product and Engineering.

 - Anticipate risks before they become issues.

 - Influence without authority across senior technical leaders.

 - Create scalable program management processes that improve organizational efficiency.

 - Drive measurable improvements in delivery, operational excellence, and customer outcomes.
   
    


YOUR TOOLKIT:

 - Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related technical field.

 - 8+ years of Technical Program Management experience in enterprise software, cloud, networking, infrastructure, or cybersecurity.

 - Experience leading large cross-functional engineering programs across Product, Engineering, QA, Security, Cloud Operations, and Customer Success.

 - Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and release management.

 - Experience managing complex technical dependencies across multiple engineering organizations.

 - Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.

 - Experience working with Jira, Confluence, Claude, Copilot or similar tools.

 - Experience with workflow automation and agent/tools building using AI and/or industry standard tools

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience working in cybersecurity, cloud, networking, SaaS, or enterprise infrastructure.

 - Familiarity with Kubernetes, containers, cloud-native architectures, APIs, distributed systems, or microservices.

 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices.

 - Experience driving SaaS releases and cloud deployments.

 - PMP, Scrum Master, or SAFe certification.

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Product Escalations
jobs.description:
ONWARDS TOGETHER!

Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.

Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave™ for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running.


LOCATION: 5 ON-SITE DAYS A WEEK IN SUNNYVALE, CA HEADQUARTERS.




OUR TEAM'S VISION:

Our Product Management team is driven by a culture that thrives on visionary leadership, autonomy, and ownership, creating a dynamic synergy that drives us forward in the ever-evolving landscape of cybersecurity. We collaborate closely with our Engineering team to tackle real-world challenges our customers face.

Bring your visionary instincts to every stage of the product lifecycle—from conception and definition to development, release, and post-release activities. You'll play a pivotal role in strategic planning, feature selection, and day-to-day tactical operations. Together, our dynamic team propels the roadmap forward as we strive to make the digital world a safer place.




YOUR IMPACT:

We are looking for a highly skilled and customer-focused Senior Escalation Manager to own the end-to-end management of customer-facing escalations that require engagement from Product, Engineering, Cloud Operations, SRE, Security, and Executive Leadership.

This role serves as the operational leader for critical issues affecting customers, ensuring that escalations are triaged effectively, routed to the appropriate teams, communicated consistently, and driven to resolution. The Senior Escalation Manager will also own post-incident governance, including Root Cause Analysis (RCA) tracking, corrective action management, and escalation program reporting.

The successful candidate combines a strong technical support background with exceptional program management, communication, and stakeholder management skills. They understand how enterprise customers experience problems, can effectively partner with engineering teams during high-pressure situations, and drive accountability across organizations to achieve customer outcomes.

This role is ideal for someone who has grown through Technical Support, Escalation Management, Technical Account Management, or Incident Management and wants to influence product and engineering execution at scale.




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Own the Escalation Lifecycle

 - Act as the central coordinator for all escalations entering the Product & Engineering organization.

 - Evaluate incoming escalation requests and ensure proper severity classification.

 - Route issues to the appropriate Product, Engineering, Cloud Operations, Security, or Platform teams.

 - Establish and maintain ownership, accountability, and visibility throughout the escalation lifecycle.

 - Monitor escalation progress and proactively remove blockers.

Drive Cross-Functional Resolution

 - Lead cross-functional meetings focused on critical customer issues.

 - Coordinate activities across Support, Customer Success, Product Management, Engineering, SRE, Operations, and Leadership.

 - Drive alignment on mitigation plans, customer commitments, and resolution strategies.

 - Escalate unresolved blockers to leadership when needed.

Manage Executive and Customer Escalations

 - Provide structured executive updates for high-priority issues.

 - Ensure field teams have timely and accurate information to communicate with customers.

 - Partner with Customer Success and Support leadership to manage high-visibility customer situations.

 - Represent Product & Engineering interests while maintaining customer advocacy.

Own RCA and Corrective Action Governance

 - Manage the Root Cause Analysis program for escalated incidents.

 - Ensure RCA timelines, reviews, approvals, and customer commitments are met.

 - Track corrective and preventative actions through completion.

 - Identify recurring issue patterns and systemic risks.

 - Partner with engineering leaders to drive long-term improvements and prevent recurrence.

Build Operational Excellence

 - Develop escalation metrics, dashboards, and executive reporting.

 - Measure escalation trends, aging, response times, SLA adherence, RCA completion, and corrective action closure.

 - Establish consistent escalation processes, standards, and governance.

 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
   
   


YOUR TOOLKIT:

Required

 - 7+ years of experience in one or more of the following:
   
   - Technical Support
   
   - Escalation Management
   
   - Technical Account Management
   
   - Incident Management
   
   - Customer Success Engineering
   
   - Technical Program Management

 - Experience managing enterprise customer escalations.

 - Strong understanding of SaaS products, cloud platforms, and enterprise software environments.

 - Proven ability to coordinate work across multiple technical organizations.

 - Experience leading cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.

 - Exceptional communication and executive presentation skills.

 - Experience driving Root Cause Analysis programs and post-incident reviews.

 - Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

 - Ability to thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous, and high-pressure situations.

Preferred

 - Previous experience as:
   
   - Escalation Manager
   
   - Major Incident Manager
   
   - Support Manager
   
   - Senior Support Engineer
   
   - Technical Account Manager
   
   - Customer Success Engineer

 - Experience working directly with Product Management and Engineering organizations.

 - Knowledge of incident management frameworks, ITIL, SRE, or operational excellence practices.

 - Experience with Jira, Salesforce, ServiceNow, PagerDuty, Zendesk, or similar systems.

Experience supporting enterprise cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, or SaaS products.




SUCCESS METRICS

The Senior Escalation Manager will be measured on:

 - Escalation acknowledgment and response SLA attainment.

 - Escalation aging and time-to-resolution.

 - RCA completion within defined timelines.

 - Corrective and preventative action closure rates.

 - Reduction in repeat incidents and recurring escalations.

 - Executive and stakeholder satisfaction.

 - Customer satisfaction during and following escalations.

 - Visibility and predictability of Product & Engineering commitments.




WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

A successful Escalation Manager acts as the "Product Manager of the Problem."

They bring clarity to chaotic situations, align multiple teams around customer outcomes, maintain executive visibility, drive ownership across organizations, and ensure every escalation results in meaningful learning and systemic improvement.

They are equally comfortable speaking with:

 - A Support Engineer investigating a case.

 - A Director of Engineering managing resources.

 - A VP reviewing customer impact.

 - A strategic customer expecting answers and accountability.

Above all, they ensure that customer-impacting issues receive the focus, urgency, and operational rigor necessary to protect customer trust and accelerate resolution.

jobs.description:

Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.

OUR TEAM'S VISION:

At Illumio, our product management team thrives on visionary leadership, customer-centric innovation, and relentless execution. We tackle the most critical and complex challenge in modern cybersecurity: stopping malicious actors and containing cyber threats before lateral movement turns an attack into a widespread business catastrophe.

As a product manager here, you will directly define, design, and drive the future of Zero Trust, micro-segmentation, and automated breach containment. You will work side-by-side with world-class engineers, strategic partners, and global enterprise customers to defend highly complex hybrid data centers and multi-cloud architectures.

If you are eager to solve massive, distributed security problems and build resilient software that the world’s largest organizations rely on daily to safeguard their critical infrastructure, join our mission and shape a safer digital future.




YOUR IMPACT:

 - Define and own the strategic vision and multi-year roadmap for advanced security workflows within the Insights platform.

 - Drive the product strategy for advanced threat detection and behavioral analysis capabilities tailored to modern security operations center (SOC) environments.

 - Partner closely with engineering leadership across multiple engineering teams to define requirements, prioritize features, and deliver capabilities through agile development cycles.

 - Collaborate directly with field teams, customers, and strategic partners to gather operational workflow requirements and validate product-market fit.

 - Develop the innovation roadmap for advanced analytical models and AI/ML-assisted features that streamline security investigation and triage.

 - Lead product planning for platform integrations with ecosystem tools, enabling security operations teams to seamlessly leverage Illumio capabilities within their existing workflows.

 - Own competitive positioning against market alternatives, partnering with Product Marketing to articulate Illumio’s unified value proposition.

 - Build and mentor a high-performing team of product managers, establishing strong PM practices as the organization scales.

 


YOUR TOOLKIT:

 - 10+ years of experience in product management or closely related roles (engineering, sales engineering, technical pre-sales) in enterprise security or networking.

 - 5+ years of product management experience shipping analytics, detection, or workflow products in the network security or cybersecurity domain.

 - 3+ years of experience managing and developing product managers.

 - Deep domain expertise in network traffic analysis, security analytics, or detection and response – with a practitioner’s understanding of how SOC teams investigate and respond to network-based threats.

 - Track record of defining and delivering enterprise SaaS products that security practitioners use daily, with demonstrable outcomes in user adoption and customer retention.

 - Experience with data-intensive security products: flow analytics, behavioral detection, SIEM/SOAR integrations, or threat intelligence platforms.

 - Established practice of utilizing data and analytics to inform product decisions, including product usage telemetry, customer engagement metrics, and market research.

 - Ability to operate at both strategic and tactical levels – setting multi-year vision while running sprint-level prioritization with engineering teams.




BONUS POINTS:

 - Product management experience at a vendor focused on network security analytics, security operations, or detection and response capabilities.

 - Experience building products that leverage network flow data (NetFlow, sFlow, IPFIX, VPC Flow Logs) for security use cases.

 - Understanding of AI/ML technologies applied to security detection – anomaly detection algorithms, graph neural networks, or LLM-based security reasoning.

 - Background in network forensics, incident response, or security operations.

 - Experience with Zero Trust architectures, microsegmentation, or network security policy management.

 - Familiarity with cloud-native data platforms designed for security analytics at scale.

jobs.description:

OUR TEAM'S VISION: 

Our Marketing team illuminates and evolves the global brand, driving revenue and empowering future success for our Sales team. As a leader in Zero Trust Segmentation, we are dedicated to helping organizations prevent cyberattacks and mitigate the impact of ransomware.

Renowned for our innovative solutions and collaborative spirit, we foster an inclusive environment within Marketing and across the company. Join one of the industry's most creative and dynamic teams, where you'll discover opportunities to excel, be empowered to set ambitious goals and define your path to success!

Product Marketing at Illumio

The Product Marketing team at Illumio focuses on understanding the customer, technology, the ecosystem, market drivers, competition and customer needs with the responsibility of communicating product messaging and value to internal and external audiences. You will be part of a team responsible for developing positioning and differentiated messaging, defining go-to-market strategy, launching new solutions and driving thought leadership for the Illumio solutions. You will 'roll up your sleeves', 'dig in', learn, problem solve, be creative and do what it takes to win the market.

The Role

Ecosystems and Growth are two of Illumio's most important accelerants to pipeline and time-to-value: our technology and cloud alliance partnerships extend our reach into other vendors' install bases, and our Product Led Growth (PLG) motion turns Web Trial and Marketplace experiences into a fast, self-serve path to value for prospects and customers.

As Director, Product Marketing, Ecosystems & Growth, you will lead both disciplines as one connected strategy — building a bench that thinks about partner-led and product-led growth as a single system rather than two separate motions. You will lead a team of three: a Product Marketing Manager driving our strategic technology and cloud alliances, a Product Marketing Manager driving our Growth/PLG trial and marketplace experience, and a Technical Marketing Manager providing the technical depth behind both. You will report to the Head of Product Marketing and represent Ecosystems & Growth in cross-functional and executive planning.

This role also serves as the technical arm of product marketing. You are not just directing technical work through your Technical Marketing Manager — you are personally credible in front of a technical audience, comfortable architecting and building a compelling product demo yourself, and able to step in and own technical proof points for a launch, a partner integration, or a Trial experience when it matters.




YOUR IMPACT:

 - Strategy and vision – Set the strategic direction for Illumio's Ecosystems & Growth practice, unifying alliance-led and product-led growth motions into a coherent plan for accelerating pipeline and customer time-to-value.

 - Technical demo ownership – Architect and build the product demos that prove Illumio's value to partners, prospects, and the field — for joint alliance integrations, for the Trial and Marketplace experience, and for major launches. Set the technical bar the team's demo environments and assets are held to, and be hands-on building or rebuilding a demo yourself when the moment calls for it.

 - Alliance marketing leadership – Own the joint messaging, positioning, and value propositions for Illumio's key technology and cloud partners, and ensure partner campaigns, co-sell enablement, and joint launches land with impact.

 - Growth and PLG leadership – Direct the strategy for the Web Trial and Marketplace experience — the journeys, landing pages, nurtures, and trial assets that turn prospects into active users — and guide your team through execution.

 - Team leadership and development – Lead, coach, and grow a team of three product marketers across alliance and growth disciplines, setting priorities, raising the bar on craft, and building their paths to the next level.

 - Cross-functional and executive partnership – Act as the senior marketing voice to Business Development, Partner Sales, Product Management, and the Office of the CTO, and represent Ecosystems & Growth priorities at the leadership table.

 - Integrated go-to-market planning – Build and direct integrated GTM plans that generate demand and pipeline through both alliance channels and PLG motions, tracking performance and reallocating investment based on results.

 - Launch integration – Ensure every major product launch has both an alliance/partner motion and a Trial/Marketplace motion built in from the start, in partnership with the broader product marketing team.

 - Market intelligence – Stay ahead of partner ecosystem trends, PLG and trial best practices from other vendors, and the competitive landscape, and translate that intelligence into strategy your team can act on.


YOUR TOOLKIT:

 - Hands-on technical depth (required, not preferred): you have personally built product demos yourself, not just briefed someone else to build them, and can speak credibly to a technical buyer or a partner's engineering team. Candidates without direct, hands-on demo-building experience will not be considered for this role, regardless of strategic or people-leadership strength.

 - 8+ years of product marketing experience in enterprise security, cloud, or infrastructure software, including at least 3 years leading and developing marketers directly.

 - Proven success setting strategic goals for a marketing function and translating them into operational plans that a team executes against.

 - Track record building technology alliance/partner marketing programs, PLG or trial-led growth motions, or both.

 - Demonstrated ability to build and maintain relationships with key industry and technology partners.

 - Strong storytelling, positioning, and messaging skills — able to translate complex technology and integrations into differentiated, customer-facing value.

 - Exceptional cross-functional leadership: comfortable driving alignment across Marketing, Product, Sales, Business Development, and executive stakeholders.

 - Comfortable setting and tracking KPIs for alliance and growth marketing programs, and adjusting strategy based on what the data shows.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to influence and guide senior executives.

 - Ability to manage competing priorities across two distinct disciplines — partner marketing and growth/PLG — with a deadline focus.

Technical Depth (Must-Have)

 - Can independently architect, build, and demo a working product environment — not just narrate a deck — for Illumio's own platform, a partner integration, or a Trial/Marketplace flow.

 - Understands the technical fundamentals of Zero Trust, microsegmentation, and hybrid/multi-cloud environments well enough to build demos that hold up under technical questioning.

 - Comfortable acting as the technical arm of product marketing: the person Sales, Solutions Engineering, and partners call when a demo needs to be built, fixed, or leveled up under a deadline.

 - Able to translate a product or partner integration's technical capability into a demo narrative that lands with both technical and business buyers.

 - Works closely with Product Management and Engineering to keep demo environments current as the platform evolves.

AI Fluency

 - Demonstrates an “AI-first” mindset: uses AI tools daily to improve the speed, quality, and reach of your own work, and sets that same expectation for your team.

 - Hands-on fluency with generative AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Microsoft Copilot for research, content drafting, competitive analysis, and positioning work.

 - Working understanding of how AI fits into the marketing and sales systems your team touches — including tools like Marketo, Salesforce, Pendo, 6sense, and Highspot — enough to identify where AI can remove manual work from trial journeys, partner enablement, and campaign reporting.

 - Comfortable evaluating and piloting new AI tools and making a clear-eyed build, buy, or adopt call for the team.

 - Understands the basics of responsible AI use — what data can and can't go into a given tool — and coaches the team to the same standard.


BONUS POINTS:

 - Experience working with or marketing to public cloud or hybrid cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

 - Familiarity with Zero Trust, segmentation, or breach containment strategies.

 - MBA or advanced degree in Marketing, Business, or a technical field.
